lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. The first column contains approximately five primary maxima, followed by subsequent columns of similar spacing toward the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance are visible on the lateral flank; high-intensity circular spots are located at the intersections of these bands and horizontal spot-alignment axes, creating a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature runs along the dorsal-lateral boundary, exhibiting a high-contrast transition from a bright superior edge to a dark inferior shadow.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance spots across its lateral surface, with approximately 10-15 discrete spots visible against the darker fin background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, high-saturation yellow-green pixel clusters (commensal organisms) positioned ventrally to the pectoral fin and along the lower midsection.
